name: Planck
summary: Cosmic-microwave-background mission that has ended data taking. Its temperature, polarization and lensing measurements constrain cold-dark-matter density and related cosmological parameters.
detection_principle: Multifrequency microwave measurements separate Galactic foregrounds and recover CMB anisotropies, fitting power spectra and gravitational-lensing statistics.

status.label: Data taking ended / historical experiment
status.evidence: ESA states that all scientific observations ended on 2013-10-03.

collaboration.name: Planck collaboration / mission team
collaboration.participants_note: Institutional participation refers to the period covered by each source; this dossier does not claim to provide a complete membership list.

key_parameters.name: Frequency coverage
key_parameters.value: 9 frequency bands; LFI 30–70 GHz, HFI 100–857 GHz

results.summary: The CMB constrains cosmic dark-matter abundance and reconstructs lensing distributions; numerical values depend on the cosmological model and data release.

science_scope: Constrains dark-matter distribution and properties through gravity, microlensing or structure statistics; does not directly identify dark-matter particles.
